description_full: Aya Gold & Silver Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of precious metals projects in Morocco. The company primarily explores for gold and silver deposits. Its flagship project holds 100% interests in the Zgounder property located east of Agadir in the Proterozoic Siroua Massif of the Anti-Atlas Range, Morocco covering an area of approximately 378 square kilometers. It has acquired strategic exploration portfolio comprising three mining licenses and 18 exploration permits covering approximately 259 km² of land across three distinct exploration projects located in Morocco. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mount Royal, Canada.

financial_summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. is a mid-cap basic materials business with a $3.7B market cap on $202M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +74% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 1% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 32%.
The company is burning through $4M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage runs at 5.4×.

Net dilution runs at 2.9% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 3.4% of the shares, and within its sector the business captures 2.1× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
